metadata.checkpoint_summary: Root CardRecord/BoardEvent correlation, deterministic idempotency, and no-send intent proof are implemented with ten passing tests. Unit 8 remains incomplete because the Supabase readback lacks its service-role key and the Discord readback validator is stale against the current multi-message card journal. The marker remains 70 percent while unit 9 proceeds independently.
